message:
the pattern read 6 of the 7 decorators the TypeScript parser holds, and not these:
      libs/components/widget/src/badge.ts:3
$reason: An internal component, exported by no entrypoint, its decorator written behind a block comment on the same line, which prettier keeps. ngc compiles it and its template's part reaches `consts` (measured through ngc in partial mode and the linker); the pattern wants the decorator in column zero, and the pattern that counted decorators before wanted it at the start of a line past indentation, so neither saw it and the case passed every point. The parser counts it, and the pattern read one decorator fewer.
